_comment: Motor mount bracket — wall-mounted plate at x_min, motor-mount face at x_max.
_architecture: Phase 5 two-region domain. Two attachment slabs: wall plate at x_min (6mm), motor face plate at x_max (6mm). Fixity at 4 wall bolt corner patches via load_case.fixed corners selector. Load concentrated at 4 NEMA bolt positions via bolt_pattern selector.
_load_case_note: Bug P1 fixed (Session 6): bolt_pattern selector applies 5000N at 4 NEMA bolt positions (~616 DOFs) instead of full face (4941 DOFs). Previous full-face load produced non-physical claw topology — optimizer built lateral flanges instead of diagonal struts.
_p2_note: Bug P2 fixed (Session 6): x_max motor face slab added to attachment_regions. Previously only x_min had a forced-solid plate. Now both mating faces are declared, as required for a two-face bracket.
_p3_note: Bug P3 fixed (Session 6): entry_seat changed from false to true. Wall-end collar overlaps the already-solid wall slab — overlap is harmless. Both faces of each NEMA through-hole are now collared.
_bc_note: bc=none on both slabs: wall slab fixity owned by load_case.fixed corners. Motor face slab has no BC (it is the load face, not the fixed face). Correct physical setup.

load_case._comment: Fixed: 4 corner disk patches at wall bolt positions on x_min face. disk_radius_m=0.006 is larger than bolt void radius 0.004 so the fixed region contains the full bolt-shank contact patch. Load: bolt_pattern at 4 NEMA centers on x_max face. disk_radius_m=0.007 matches wall_radius_m of bolt_seat collars so load lands exactly on the forced-solid collar region.

attachment_regions._comment: Wall plate — 6mm slab at x_min. Forced solid, bc=none. Fixity owned by load_case.fixed corner disks (disk_radius=6mm > bolt_void_radius=4mm, so fixed region fully contains the bolt hole surround). 4 wall bolt clearance holes at corners.

Motor face plate — 6mm slab at x_max. Forced solid, bc=none (load face, not fixed face). Load applied via bolt_pattern in load_case.load. 4 NEMA bolt clearance holes punched through at standard NEMA-17 31mm pitch pattern centered at Y=30mm, Z=40mm.

bolt_seats._comment: NEMA-17 motor bolt through-holes. void_radius=4mm clears M3 bolt shank. wall_radius=7mm forced-solid collar matches load disk radius so load lands on solid material. seat_depth=8mm collar at both faces. entry_seat=true: wall-end collar overlaps x_min slab (already nondesign) — overlap is harmless but ensures both collar faces are declared consistently.

boundary_conditions._comment: Legacy FEniCSx NB03 path only — not used by Rust solver (NB04).
